sonnet.problem: The recap of Luke 22:21 is garbled. 'The hand of His betrayer is right there on the table with His' is an unfinished phrase, and the text says the hand is 'with Me on the table'. The card does not read correctly and misstates the verse.
sonnet.rule: Clear English. Every card reads correctly.

sonnet.problem: This story card only re-tells verses 28-30, which cards 9-11 already told or asked about. It adds no new part of the passage, and it sits after the choice cards on verses 29 and 30 even though it cites 28-30. It works as a recap with a joke.
The card tells Peter's readiness to go to prison and to death, and it jokes on exactly those words ('PRISON. And DEATH.'). A card that tells death carries no joke.
sonnet.rule: Heavy moments. A card that tells death, violence, abuse, serious sin or the body's private matters has no joke.

sonnet.problem: The closing line adds details the passage doesn't give: 'this night is just getting started' puts a time on the scene, and 'the table talk ends for now' adds a fact. A storyteller's line may carry the moment but not add facts.
sonnet.rule: Times stay true. No time in the text means none added.
